name: Tomato, Kale & Cannellini Bean Skillet with Parmesan Polenta

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, bring broth and water to a boil. Reduce heat to low and gradually add polenta in a thin steady stream, while whisking, until the polenta is incorporated into the liquid. Cook, stirring occasionally, until polenta is soft and the texture is creamy, 15-25 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
3 cup water
1 ½ cups polenta (cornmeal)

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Peel and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic; place both in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, seed, and medium dice bell peppers; add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add beans, tomatoes, and spices to the pot; stir to combine, and cook until heated through, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp paprika
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces.
Add kale to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 5 minutes.
While the kale cooks, finely grate Parmesan.
Add half the Parmesan, salt, and pepper to the polenta and stir to combine. If the polenta is too firm, add hot water, a few tablespoons at a time, until you reach a desired consistency.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide polenta between bowls; top with veggie-bean skillet and remaining Parmesan. Enjoy!
